name: Bakonypéterd (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bakonypéterd: a red and yellow shield with a tree, a saint and a bough, above a yellow scroll inscribed BAKONYPÉTERD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
